Name: Shane De-Drunkifier
Author: RyanhMODs
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

I made this in response to a Tweet (and also for a bit of fun and modding experimentation).

Specifically, this edits several lines of his marriage dialogue to replace mentions of alcohol, removes the beer cans and dirty footprints from his room in the farmhouse, replaces the beer and pale ale he sometimes gifts the player, and marks alcoholic beverages as a disliked gift for him.

You can disable the changes to the beer cans, floor stains, gifts, and dialogue through the in-game mod menu or the config file in the mod folder. The cans and floor stains won't require a game restart, but the gifts and dialogue changes might.

If there's any additional changes or additions anyone would like to see, let me know and I'll see about adding it. I may potentially add an option for a more in-depth overhaul of his dialogue to make him a less unpleasant bachelor.


[b][size=5]Install instructions[/size][/b]

1. Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Start the game with SMAPI.
4. Enjoy a spouse who isn't an alcoholic.


[b][size=5]See Also[/size][/b]

Nothing. This is my only mod for this game, and I'm including this section for purely aesthetic reasons.
